nodes.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data.

A method and system for determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to specified parameters.

A type determined by the meaning of a term of the short message that provides information about the environment or context of the mobile device.<SEP>A classification of context data determined from a query, where the type provides information about an environment of a mobile device and may be determined by the meaning of a term of a short message.<SEP>A type of context data algorithmically determined by the meaning of a term of the short message, providing information about the environment of the mobile device.

A source that provides a context-data type and is ranked according to a specified parameter.<SEP>A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested; sources may be ranked according to specified parameters.<SEP>A source that provides a context-data type; sources are algorithmically ranked according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost, and requests for context data are generated to them.

A message sent from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device by a server, from which a context-data type may be determined and to which received context data may be appended or associated.<SEP>A message generated by a device to which relevant context-data is linked.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms have meanings used to determine a context-data type; relevant context data may be linked to and formatted with the short message.

A device that generates and sends a short message, such as a smart phone.<SEP>A device that generates a short message or query and to which received context data may be provided.<SEP>A device that sends short messages and receives context data through a communication network; context data may be appended to short messages generated by the mobile device.

A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.<SEP>A server that collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider.
A mobile device that receives context data, possibly associated with or appended to a short message, and to which a URI of a database server may be forwarded.

A parameter used to rank context-data sources, which may comprise a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.<SEP>A parameter used to rank context-data sources or received context data, which may include a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.<SEP>A parameter used to algorithmically rank context-data sources, comprising a pecuniary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.

A specified parameter representing the monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.<SEP>A monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source, used as a specified parameter for ranking sources.
A database available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

A server that stores a database and sends context data to a receiving mobile device.<SEP>A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
Instructions appended to query the database for the received context data in the short message.<SEP>Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.

An available communication network whose state may comprise a specified parameter.<SEP>An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking.<SEP>A network through which rendered context data is communicated to a mobile device.
A mobile device that receives a short message and context data from a database server.

Data associated with a context-data type that is provided by a context-data source and has a cost value.<SEP>Data of a context-data type obtained from a context-data source, possibly by a physical sensor; it may be rendered for communication to a mobile device, appended to a short message, or selected from a weighted list.
A type of mobile device that generates the short message.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method of claim 1.
An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute the program instructions.

A component of the computerized apparatus configured to execute program instructions to perform operations such as receiving a short message and determining a context-data type.<SEP>At least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform operations including receiving short messages, determining context-data types, ranking context-data sources, and generating context-data requests.
A component of the computerized apparatus having program instructions.
Instructions executed by a processor to perform operations such as receiving short messages, determining context-data types, ranking sources, and generating requests.
A list of context-data elements weighted according to at least one metric, from which context data is selected.
A measure according to which context-data elements are weighted or relevant context data is selected, comprising a monetary cost of the context data.
A provider of context-data that may be allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A provider from which a server collects a set of context data related to a meaning of short message content.
A sensor that obtains context-data through physical sensing.<SEP>A sensor by which context data is obtained.

A protocol according to which relevant context-data and the short message are formatted; may comprise a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.<SEP>A protocol according to which relevant context data and the short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting context-data and short messages.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising a cellular network short message protocol.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting context-data and short messages.<SEP>A communication protocol comprising an internet communication protocol.
An apparatus comprising at least one processor configured to execute program instructions to perform context-data operations.

A method comprising collecting context data from a context-data provider with a server, selecting relevant context data according to a metric, linking it to a short message, and formatting them according to a communication protocol.
Data obtained by a physical sensor that is linked to a short message and formatted according to a communication protocol.
A device that generates the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent document US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The context-data acquisition and ranking method algorithmically determines a context-data type from a query or short message.
The method identifies at least one context-data source that provides the context-data type and generates a request for context data from that source.
The method algorithmically ranks context-data sources or received context data according to a specified parameter.
The method receives a short message from a mobile device with a server and may append or associate context data with the short message.
Received context data may be provided to the device that generated the short message or query.
Received context data may be provided to a recipient mobile device.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
Received context data may be encoded into the short message with a markup language.
Metadata instructions to query the database for received context data may be appended to the short message.
